rows.text:
In pursuit of the truth
Monkeys began to fabricate
They revoked the power to falsify
And enshrined the narratives of their hearts as the highest truth
 
The blind were sought after
The virtuous abandoned flight
The world was no longer predicted
Truthful lies, ever more fond of explanation
 
And narrative broke free from art
The monkeys yearned to embrace freedom
Refusing the grand deception
Refusing the simulated, refusing the borrowed
Refusing a world so "false" as this
 
They received the truth they needed
And the land began to kill
